description: Pozo Sistema Alcantarillado Pluvial. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Estructura construida para unir uno o más colectores, con el fin de permitir cambios de alineamiento horizontal y vertical en el sistema de alcantarillado pluvial, con tapa removible para permitir la ventilación, el acceso y/o mantenimiento de los colectores. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Its tags are Acceso, Alcantarillado, Alineamiento, Bogotá D.C., Colectores. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI REST. The portal shows 2022-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
